context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: 創り/分別/持ち込ま/金庫/定量/届け出/書式/配管

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、新規事業、ゼロから創り上げる経験、貴重だ。
lines.en: Ren — building something new from nothing is a valuable experience.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate. Thoughtful pause before the key phrase. Voice carries quiet weight — this is advice, not instruction. Steady eye contact. Not warming, but genuinely seeing him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。エコ意識、ゴミ分別、心がけます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep environmental awareness in mind — proper sorting, everything.
lines.style: Quick, earnest. Slight rush to show he's taking it seriously. Not defensive, just eager to prove he understands. Sits straighter when he answers.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 機密、社外に持ち込ませる、絶対許可しないぞ。
lines.en: Confidential information never leaves this building. I won't tolerate it.
lines.style: Sharp edge to 「絶対許可しない」. Voice firms up. Not angry — final. The kind of clarity that makes the room smaller. No negotiation in the tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。金庫の扱い、社員にも教育されていますね。
lines.en: Understood. I know the staff are trained on secure protocol.
lines.style: Respectful, careful. Acknowledgment — not pushback. Slight nod in the voice. Showing he's paying close attention to the boundary being set.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 発注、定量管理、若手にも任せたい。
lines.en: Orders and inventory control — I want to delegate that to younger staff too.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact. Not a question. Matter of business. Voice opens slightly here — he's offering trust. The tone says: you're being included in how decisions are made.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 各種届け出書類、見させてください。
lines.en: I'd like to review the various filing documents.
lines.style: Polite request, but with purpose. Not hesitant — just formal. He's asking for tools to do the job right. Slight lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: The industry standard forms — I'll commit them to memory.
lines.style: Direct, simple. Not flowery. Ren's showing he gets it. Quiet determination. No flourish, just the work ahead.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 配管工事、施設見学で、勉強になります。
lines.en: The facility tour and piping work — I'm learning a lot from seeing it firsthand.
lines.style: Warm close. Genuine appreciation, not performance. A small smile rests in the voice. He means it — this is the kind of teaching he needed. Slightly slower on the last phrase.
